Aim_Off_0: Keep your shooting elbow tucked under the ball so it flies straight.
Aim_Off_1: Line your arm up with the basket before releasing for a straight shot.
Aim_Off_2: Point your fingers straight at the rim when letting go of the ball.
Arc_Too_Flat_0: Lift your elbow above eye level so the ball arcs high toward the hoop.
Arc_Too_Flat_1: Reach up high on your follow-through to give the ball a higher arc.
Arc_Too_Flat_2: Aim high above the rim so the ball drops softly into the basket.
Low_Velocity_0: Extend your shooting arm fully upward to give your shot more power.
Low_Velocity_1: Push with your entire arm, not just your wrist, for more power.
Low_Velocity_2: Push the ball upward with smooth energy so it carries to the basket.
Jerky_Motion_0: Keep your arm moving smoothly without pausing before you release the ball.
Jerky_Motion_1: Relax your shoulder and arm so your shooting motion stays smooth.
Jerky_Motion_2: Release the ball in one smooth upward rhythm from start to finish.
